content.text: {"subject":"Math","mode":"concept","extracted_questions":null,"concept_explanation":"When you add 24 + 13, break it into tens and ones: 24 has 2 tens and 4 ones, and 13 has 1 ten and 3 ones. Ask your child: 'If we put the tens together, how many tens do we have? And if we put the ones together, how many ones?' Then combine: 3 tens and 7 ones make 37.","aditiApplicable":true,"aditiHook":"Your child already knows that 10 + 10 = 20, so this is just building on that: grouping tens with tens and ones with ones makes any addition simpler."}
